coverage.main_44100: 12 combinations of OFF/I/II × POLY off/on × overlap/gap, plus40 intensity/TIME/interval/direction cases
coverage.reuse_44100: Two8-note separated sequences; two6-voice simultaneous steal/reuse sequences
coverage.48000: Eight selected mono timing/mode cases plus two8-note sequences
coverage.return_44100: Two mono held-note return cases: release72 while60 remains held, modesI andII.

limitations: Autocorrelation uses a1536-sample frame and220-sample hop; timing tolerance roughly20ms. The first10-cent arrival threshold is not the exact algorithmic duration.
Multiple simultaneous pitches invalidate a single-pitch estimate; poly-steal pitch is analyzed only after the old voices are released.
Pitch search excludes periods>=400samples; fresh modeII initial MIDI42 is outside the estimator untilitglidesup. StaticREA independentlyconfirmsinitial42.
No envelope/retrigger amplitude analysis, sustainpedal/MPE/MIDI channel/arp interaction, mid-noteparameterchanges, or DAW GUI tests.
No KODA source was changed. Reference-only offline AU evidence. CPUtime andpeakmemory were notmeasured.

plot.method: Measured trajectory polylines rendered withPillow; matplotlib unavailable; no fitted theoretical curves.
